name: APT36 Initial Access 1 - Shortcut (.lnk) Execution (T1204.002)
blast_radius: Creates a run-tagged .lnk with a double extension (Invoice_Q3.pdf.lnk) pointing at cmd.exe and opens it the way a user double-click would. Benign; removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: cmd.exe launched from explorer.exe or the shell
detection: EDR: double-extension shortcut launching cmd.exe from a temp path

name: APT36 Execution 1 - Document-to-Script Chain via wscript.exe (T1059.005)
blast_radius: Runs a run-tagged VBScript with wscript.exe //B //Nologo that writes one marker file. Benign; removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: wscript.exe with a .vbs path
detection: EDR: wscript.exe launched silently from a document-adjacent path

name: APT36 Execution 2 - Encoded PowerShell Hidden Child (T1059.001)
blast_radius: Runs PowerShell -EncodedCommand -WindowStyle Hidden as a child process that writes one marker file. Benign; removed and verified.
detection: EDR: hidden-window encoded PowerShell child process

name: APT36 Execution 3 - WMI Process Creation (T1047)
blast_radius: Calls Win32_Process.Create to run cmd.exe echoing a marker, an alternate execution path to a direct process launch. Benign; removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: cmd.exe with WmiPrvSE.exe parent
detection: EDR: process created by WmiPrvSE.exe from a script host

name: APT36 Execution 4 - CHM (HTML Help) Shortcut Object Execution (T1218.001)
blast_radius: Compiles a run-tagged .chm (if hhc.exe is present; otherwise not_applicable) whose embedded Shortcut object runs a command, and opens it with hh.exe. Benign; removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: hh.exe with a .chm path
detection: EDR: hh.exe spawning a child process via a Shortcut object
